title: Unless you use frozen pie crusts, DO NOT GET THIS!
text:
Unless you use frozen pie crusts, DO NOT GET THIS!. I had gotten this as a package deal - with the Good Cook Red 9 Inch Ceramic Pie Plate - which was suggested by Amazon. It says it would fit a pie up to 10 inches. This is a complete falsehood. It will fit a 9 Inch frozen pie crust, but that's it. It's deceptive to imply they are compatible.

I would send it back, but it's not worth the trouble or the cost it's going to take to return it. If I had known about this, I would never have gotten it. I'll just have to use aluminum foil, which would have been a lot less hassle and much more affordable.
